classification.difficultyReason: Match waiting to horizontal segments and travel direction to rising or falling segments, using the explicitly taught graph meanings.

content.prompt: Match each of these descriptions to one of the graphs below.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, first graph in the horizontal comparison row
spec.description: Graph A: arrowed axes labelled d and t; a horizontal segment above the origin followed by a straight descent to the time axis. No ticks or grid.
spec.mathematics: Distance from home remains constant, then decreases uniformly to zero. Coordinates encode schematic proportions only, not numerical data.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph and its choice label remain visible in the question edition; the matching answer is stored separately.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, second graph in the horizontal comparison row
spec.description: Graph B: arrowed axes labelled d and t; one straight rising segment from the origin. No ticks or grid.
spec.mathematics: Distance from home increases uniformly from zero throughout the journey. Coordinates encode schematic proportions only, not numerical data.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph and its choice label remain visible in the question edition; the matching answer is stored separately.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, third graph in the horizontal comparison row
spec.description: Graph C: arrowed axes labelled d and t; one straight descending segment from the vertical axis to the time axis. No ticks or grid.
spec.mathematics: Distance from home decreases uniformly to zero throughout the journey. Coordinates encode schematic proportions only, not numerical data.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph and its choice label remain visible in the question edition; the matching answer is stored separately.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, fourth graph in the horizontal comparison row
spec.description: Graph D: arrowed axes labelled d and t; a horizontal segment above the origin followed by a straight rising segment. No ticks or grid.
spec.mathematics: Distance from home remains constant, then increases uniformly. Coordinates encode schematic proportions only, not numerical data.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph and its choice label remain visible in the question edition; the matching answer is stored separately.

children.label: a
children.prompt: I left home and travelled at a constant speed for the entire journey.

answer.worked: B. The straight rising line starts at home and shows a constant speed away from home.

children.label: b
children.prompt: I returned home travelling at a constant speed.

answer.worked: C. The straight falling line shows a constant speed towards home, ending at zero distance from home.

children.label: c
children.prompt: I waited for my friend to arrive, then we travelled home at a constant speed.

answer.worked: A. The horizontal segment shows waiting. The straight falling segment then shows a constant speed towards home.

children.label: d
children.prompt: I waited for my friend to arrive, then we completed the journey at a constant speed

answer.worked: D. The horizontal segment shows waiting. The straight rising segment then shows a constant speed away from home.
